notes: Roleplay and Avatar Sim on the prompt's own word - animal RP, where picking an animal is a morph rather than a species sim - so this is Morph Roleplay and not the Animal Sim bundle, which the genre file warns has no town at all: cars, roads and houses rule out wilderness-open and den-shelter outright. Shape is settlement-static because the housing answer rules out claiming and says any house can be entered in a shared town, which is the model where personalization lives on the avatar and never on property. The P3 is not an assumption but the stated feature - houses you sleep in and enter freely - and it is the only modifier here, since a static settlement carries none of its own. Added path-road-vehicle for the cars, which is what pins the street widths, and kept the preset's square, backdrop spots and orientation landmark; I left district-zoned off because nothing in the brief separates shops from homes, and read 'modern and suburban' as the theme of the same one town rather than a second density pick.
